inputs: Real positive g,h, real detuning delta, nonnegative bath occupation n. Fixed external preparation and Markov input-output convention. Occupation is an independent source input, not inferred from response or fitted to output noise.
records: Four existing transfer rows labelled (leaf,i), i=0..3, and one scalar preparation row labelled (occupation,1), with source=target=(bath-state,1) and value=n. The latter is a typed preparation datum, NOT a transfer edge.
operation: Existing incoming_promotion, unchanged, under inherited/common policies; all five source records enter before the first promotion and remain recoverable through recursive members.
aggregate_semantics: Mixed-role scalar means are transport summaries only, not physical amplitudes or noise. Physical evaluation uses typed recovered leaves, never the aggregate.
presentations: Raw/from-indexed/to-indexed records and existing index/unindex comparison maps, without an added cone wrapper.
readout: Recover and validate the five source leaves. Apply the existing path-composition transfer readout only to the four transfer rows. Read n from the recovered occupation row. Compute r,q, commutator weight, and added occupation |q|^2*n.
failure_policy: Reject missing, duplicate, negative or untyped occupation records; do not silently default to vacuum or consult a saved input model.
scope: Prepared Markov transfer/noise interface for independent occupation-only bath preparations. Does not represent arbitrary bath density operators, squeezed/correlated baths, all physical-domain operations, or full fluctuation-dissipation.
authority_boundary: Declared source-schema adapter using the existing executable promotion, not a newly proved native WG derivation or a derivation of the analytic noise law. The old frozen contract remains falsified on the larger prepared domain.
